# CSwapBar

> CSwapBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app (macOS 14+, Apple Silicon) for CSwap (claude-swap). It shows 5-hour and weekly usage for every Claude Code account, switches accounts in one click, warns before usage limits, and can live at the MacBook notch. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic or CSwap. MIT licensed. Current version: 0.2.0.

CSwapBar is Mac only. It needs CSwap 1.1.0 or later (`uv tool install claude-swap`, then `cswap add` per account). It stores no credentials, has no backend or telemetry, and only contacts GitHub for an optional update check.
